update_commands.0x55: prepare runtime-image update; clears gp+0xaf and validates the trailing 14-byte value via 0xc9a
update_commands.0x53: begin runtime-image update; accepts only target byte 1 after 14-byte validation, then sets gp+0xaf

write_page_flow.resident_copy_slot: 0x4004c tmos_memcpy; used only when payload+2 is not word-aligned
write_page_flow.erase: 0x110c calls local 0x2066 for one 0x100-byte fast erase; the page handler invokes it four times per 1 KiB page
write_page_flow.program: 0x110c calls local 0x2094 for one 0x100-byte fast program; invoked at offsets 0,0x100,0x200,0x300
write_page_flow.verify: word-by-word read-back compare; mismatch aborts the page

flash_controller.clock_setup: 0x110c compares gp+0x80 to 144000000 Hz; it ORs RCC CFGR0 at 0x40021004 with HPRE DIV2 (0x80) or DIV4 (0x90), then clears those bits afterward
flash_controller.error_handling: polls BSY/WR_BSY without timeout; does not test PGERR, WRPRTERR, or EOP; wrapper has no status return

notes: This boot image programs only the runtime slot. The runtime image contains a complementary updater for the boot slot.
Both images use low linked/execution views distinct from their 0x08000000 flash aliases; the mapping mechanism remains unknown.
This is the safety-critical mapping: do not exercise 0x55/0x53/0x57/0x52/0x45 without a hardware recovery path.
